name: Orascom Development Holding
source: Orascom Development Holding AG consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, Deloitte AG), consolidated cash flow statement pages F-8 to F-9. Currency CHF, absolute units.
note: Consolidated cash flow statement, CHF absolute units. Capital Expenditure is the printed payments for property, plant and equipment and investment property, stored negative as the dataset convention. Free Cash Flow is derived as Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure. Net Change in Cash is the printed net increase in cash and bank balances (FY2025: 56780125). The printed effects of exchange rate changes on cash (FY2025: (16894934); FY2024: (49564347)) are not represented in the panel row set. FY2025 ties, printed: Operating 81240015 plus Investing (56815123) plus Financing 32355233 equals the printed net increase 56780125. FY2024 and FY2023 cells are the statement's own comparatives and reproduce the values already stored.
